newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HARFORD APPOINTED WEST BROM MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HARFORD APPOINTED WEST BROM MANAGER.

text.p: Ray Harford, who quit as boss of 1995 English premier league champions Blackburn three months ago, became first division West Bromwich's eighth manager in 13 years on Thursday.
He replaces Alan Buckley who was sacked last month.
Harford, who has also had managerial stints with Wimbledon, Luton and Fulham, was coach when Blackburn, then managed by Kenny Dalglish, won the championship.
But the club struggled after he succeeded Dalglish as manager and were bottom of the premier league when he quit in October.
